The [http://www.dlink.com/products/?tab=3.driver&pid=DWL-650&rev=DWL-650K1 drivers on the D-Link USA site] only reference one device - 104c:8400 (1186:3b02). The device is almost certainly a Global Sun product (equivalent to the [[D-Link DWL-650+ rev A1]] / [[Global Sun GL242201-0T]] or [[D-Link DWL-650+ rev B1]] / [[Global Sun GL242201-MT]]).
